text: I think it's mainly about lifestyle. People in cities work long hours, move flats quite often and spend most of their free time online, so there's little chance to bump into the people next door. Big apartment blocks make it worse, because you can live somewhere for years and only ever see neighbours in the lift. In villages, by contrast, everyone's lives overlap naturally.

tips.en: I think it's mainly about lifestyle gives the answer first and the details after.
tips.kk: I think it's mainly about lifestyle — жауап бірінші сөйлемде, толығырақ кейін.
tips.ru: I think it's mainly about lifestyle — ответ в первой фразе, подробности потом.
tips.example: I think it's mainly about lifestyle

tips.en: In villages, by contrast rounds off the answer without repetition.
tips.kk: In villages, by contrast — салыстыру қайталаусыз қорытынды шығарады.
tips.ru: In villages, by contrast — сравнение подводит итог без повторов.

questions.question: Why do people in cities often not know their neighbours?

text: For me, a good neighbour is someone who respects your privacy but is there when you need them. That means keeping the noise down late at night and not blocking the stairs with bikes, but also being willing to water your plants or take in a parcel while you're away. Basically, it's a balance between minding your own business and being helpful.

tips.en: Respects your privacy but is there when you need them defines the idea as a balance.
tips.kk: Respects your privacy but is there when you need them — теңгерім арқылы берілген анықтама.
tips.ru: Respects your privacy but is there when you need them — определение через баланс.
tips.example: respects your privacy but is there when you need them

tips.en: Watering plants and taking in a parcel make the answer convincing.
tips.kk: Water your plants or take in a parcel — тұрмыстық деректер жауапты нанымды етеді.
tips.ru: Water your plants or take in a parcel — бытовые детали делают ответ убедительным.
tips.example: water your plants or take in a parcel

note.en: “Not getting involved in other people’s affairs”.

questions.followUp: Have you ever had a difficult neighbour?
questions.question: What makes someone a good neighbour?

text: Up to a point, yes. Most countries already have rules about quiet hours, but in practice they're rarely enforced, so people just put up with loud music or late-night renovation. I'd rather see better sound insulation in new buildings, though, because rules only deal with the symptoms. If walls were thicker, half of these arguments between neighbours simply wouldn't happen.

tips.en: Up to a point, yes is more honest and stronger than a simple yes.
tips.kk: Up to a point, yes — жай «иә» дегеннен шынайы әрі күшті.
tips.ru: Up to a point, yes — честнее и сильнее, чем просто «да».

tips.en: I'd rather see offers a better option than the one in the question.
tips.kk: I'd rather see … — сұрақтағыдан жақсырақ нұсқа ұсынасыз.
tips.ru: I'd rather see … — вы предлагаете вариант лучше, чем в вопросе.
tips.example: I'd rather see better sound insulation in new buildings

note.ru: «Борются со следствием, а не с причиной».

questions.question: Should there be stricter rules about noise in apartment buildings?

text: Quite dramatically, I'd say. Most buildings in my city now have a group chat, and it's become the main way people report problems, organise repairs or find a lost cat. On the positive side, it saves time and gets things done. The downside is that arguments which would have stayed polite face to face can get quite heated online.

tips.en: On the positive side and The downside is hold the answer together.
tips.kk: On the positive side … The downside is — екі байланыстырушы сөз жауапты ұстап тұр.
tips.ru: On the positive side … The downside is — две связки держат ответ.

tips.en: Reporting problems, organising repairs and finding a lost cat are three quick examples.
tips.kk: Report problems, organise repairs or find a lost cat — үш жылдам мысал.
tips.ru: Report problems, organise repairs or find a lost cat — три быстрых примера.
tips.example: report problems, organise repairs or find a lost cat

questions.followUp: Do older residents use them too?
questions.question: How have online chats for residents changed the way neighbours communicate?

text: Yes, I think so. When you know the people around you, you notice if something's wrong — a stranger trying door handles, or an elderly neighbour who hasn't been seen for days. Neighbours who trust each other also tend to keep an eye on children playing outside. So in a way, a friendly community does a job that no security camera can do.

tips.en: A stranger trying door handles gives a picture instead of general words about safety.
tips.kk: A stranger trying door handles — қауіпсіздік туралы жалпы сөздің орнына нақты көрініс.
tips.ru: A stranger trying door handles — картинка вместо общих слов о безопасности.

tips.en: Does a job that no security camera can do is a memorable last line.
tips.kk: Does a job that no security camera can do — есте қалатын соңғы сөйлем.
tips.ru: Does a job that no security camera can do — запоминающаяся последняя фраза.
tips.example: a friendly community does a job that no security camera can do
